positive_snippets: What an amazing hotel it is. Superb facilities with top class service. Staff  were polite and friendly. The staff is not only professional and but also genuinely warm and attentive, making sure every detail of the stay feels personalized. I would highly recommend this hotel.

This is a fabulous hotel with lovely facilities and beautiful rooms . Great location too. Food was outstanding. This is the best hotel I have ever stayed. Front desk guys are very humble, polite and positive, they have very delightful, smiling face.
negative_snippets: Very disappointing stay. The room condition was completely different from what was advertised. Bedsheets, pillowcases, and towels were torn and stained. Toiletries were barely provided, and the bathroom was dirty with non-functional taps. Even after complaining and changing rooms, the condition remained poor. The next morning there was no running water, and the staff response was not helpful. Would not recommend this hotel.

Extremely disappointing stay. The washroom was dirty and the door didn’t even lock. The bed wasn’t clean, we found hair on it, and shockingly, there were used protection in the drawers. Towels were provided but were clearly not washed properly. Even the bottled water looked suspicious and felt fake. The entire room was dusty and unhygienic, and we ended up catching a cold just before our flight. Would not recommend this place at all
